partial_label.strategy: Same-image merge of Roboflow generic labels onto approved custom Roboflow images; extra Roboflow images only if the source file has no pole/bollard/barricade/tree_trunk/stairs/curb labels; COCO chair images keep other selected COCO generics on the same image.
partial_label.accessibility_barriers_unlabeled_generic: HIGH residual risk. Accessibility Barriers labels are stairs/curb only. People, chairs, and vehicles that appear in those photos are not labeled and may be treated as background.
partial_label.coco_unlabeled_custom_hazards: COCO chair images do not label pole/bollard/stairs/curb/barrier/tree_trunk. Indoor chair photos make unlabeled sidewalk hazards less likely, but any outdoor COCO scene still has this risk.
partial_label.pending_poles_on_custom_images: 1,418 pole staging rows remain PENDING and are not in this dataset. Some Roboflow images may still contain unlabeled poles.
partial_label.recommendation: Partial labels are unavoidable for Accessibility Barriers. Do not drop those stairs/curb images. Prefer the same-image Roboflow merge (applied). Do not train a second detector. Monitor person/car false positives on indoor stairs photos. Future work: ignore-regions or person labels on Accessibility Barriers.
